UN Chief Warns AI Development Outpacing Global Oversight

United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has cautioned that artificial intelligence is advancing faster than global oversight mechanisms can keep pace. He urged the international community to establish global rules to govern AI development, highlighting potential risks, including threats to humanity and the need to protect children. The warnings come amid growing concerns about the rapid evolution of AI technologies.
